title: Sequential OR decision tree construction
statement: For a finite set of available coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, define a decision tree that queries the least available coordinate. If its value is $-1$, the tree returns $-1$; otherwise it continues recursively on the remaining coordinates. If no coordinates are available, it returns $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set of available coordinates among the first $n$ coordinates
